verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a 2026-10-07 probe of https://aima.gov.pt/robots.txt that failed TLS certificate verification, so no robots.txt content was retrieved and the agent cannot learn its read permissions before fetching. The probe mentions an earlier dossier that saw an open robots.txt, but that is a second-hand note with no separate citation. One failed probe gives no independent second tier to support 'disputed', and the axis applies to a public service website, so the verdict is 'none' rather than 'na'.
